args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions. Rollback verified (status: rolled_out).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** checkout-api: current version `v2.3.1` was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: reviewed deployment history and found `v2.3.0` was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was the failing deploy).

3. **Rolled back** checkout-api to `v2.3.0` in all production regions — verified as `rolled_out`.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`) describing the health-check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0, which paged the on-call engineer.
